name: Asserting (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These weapons were developed to fight tricky spellcasters. When attacking a creature, an asserting weapon ignores any miss chance created by an illusion effect (including supernatural abilities that mimic an illusion effect like a hellcat’s invisible in light ability). In addition, when scoring a critical hit against a creature under the effect of any illusion spell you may make a dispel attempt against one illusion affecting the target using your character level in place of your caster level.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dispel magic
